verdict.rationale: Together's serverless docs say developers can call 100+ open-source models with per-token pricing and no provisioning latency, across chat, image, audio and embedding, through one API. Community users confirm hosted open-weight models such as Llama-2-70B at low per-token prices. Missing for 10: an explicit current catalog naming Qwen, DeepSeek and GPT-OSS families on serverless, and independent confirmation of how current and broad the catalog is.
